name: specification
title: Requirements specification
for_each: select id,code from documents order by code

sections.title: Requirements and procedures
sections.sql: select code,heading,body,source,method,owner,status,revision from items where document_id=$1 order by code
sections.note: Controlled copy only after human review and baseline approval.

name: verification-matrix
title: Requirements verification matrix
for_each: select id,code from documents order by code

sections.title: Coverage and current evidence
sections.sql: select v.code,v.heading,v.linked_tests,v.current_passes,v.latest_failures,v.stale_results from v_verification v join items i on i.id=v.id where i.document_id=$1 order by v.code

sections.title: Recorded evidence
sections.sql: select req.code as requirement,t.code as procedure,x.result,x.evidence,x.actor,x.created_at from items req join links l on l.to_id=req.id and l.kind='verification' join items t on t.id=l.from_id left join v_latest_runs x on x.test_id=t.id where req.document_id=$1 order by req.code,t.code
sections.note: A recorded pass is not current proof when the coverage section marks it stale.

name: review-record
title: Requirement review record
for_each: select id,code from items where kind='requirement' order by code

sections.title: Change and note history
sections.sql: select actor,action,note,before_data,after_data,created_at from activity where record_id=$1 order by sequence
